title: Complete acquisition token can release correlation/result overlap while result is live
basis: Fresh independent desired-property witness against the frozen final source, adding only one private cfg(test) method; product core bytes unchanged.
contract: PA06/H11 requires complete original retirement only after every child, proof, result, borrow and backing carrier has ended. Correlation storage/work is prepaid within the original acquisition reservation before publication.
trace: Private host fixture passes the actual owning admission core; the actual host validator constructs a proof with its own source Box.
correlation_scope_core_v1 borrows the live admitted owner and yields one attempt plus expected value.
correlate_core_v1 consumes the attempt and entire fixed typed carrier, returning a matched carrier containing the same real proof, four resource guards and usage.
After the expected/attempt borrows end, the matched carrier has no owner lifetime or retirement obligation. The same admitted owner can be consumed while that carrier is live.
retire_acquired_owner_core_v1 drops all thirteen acquired guard resources and backing, returning CompleteAcquisitionRetirementV1 without checking correlation-result survival.
CompleteAcquisitionRetirementV1::release_v1 releases the whole original acquisition storage, including the fixed correlation/result overlap; the result still owns its proof and four loader guards.
reachability_limits: The witness is a private host-component use of the real shared generic production core, with guard resources and validator-created proof; it is not a native File or fixture run.
The present concrete outer caller explicitly destroys its child result before acquisition retirement, so this witness does not establish a refund through that caller.
NativeInputBridgeV1::retire_v1 always refuses healthy completion. Native admission and bootstrap remain Pending. No currently reachable native complete-token refund is established.

The failed invariant prevents accepting the generic token as proof that all charged correlation/result carriers have ended. Enabling a future successful native retirement bridge would require correction.
required_resolution: Tie outstanding correlation/result ownership to acquisition retirement using a closed lifetime/ownership protocol, or retain the relevant storage conservatively until complete original result retirement. A manually correct positive caller order does not make the shared generic complete token certify this missing condition.
preserve_witness: Keep the current failure and exact original source. The unchanged desired outcome is no whole acquisition release while a correlated success, mismatch or loader-error carrier remains live; a refusal or compiler-enforced prevention is acceptable.
